highlights.title: Scroll back for earlier messages
highlights.line: In a long conversation, scroll up and earlier messages load by themselves, and the message you were reading stays where it was.

highlights.title: Qwen in Add a provider
highlights.line: Add a provider now offers Qwen, run on this computer through Ollama or at an address you give, and asks before a large download.

highlights.title: Moved agents keep your imports answer
highlights.line: Moving a Claude agent to another Claude account carries your answer to the allow external imports question with it.

highlights.title: Long task and room messages arrive whole
highlights.line: A message from a colleague or a room now reaches an agent in one piece, unless it is longer than a chat message can be.

highlights.title: Gemini stays on the tested version
highlights.line: A Gemini agent no longer updates the gemini program on its own, so it keeps the version Kosmos was tested with.
